## Change and evidence

Link the issue and describe how to reproduce the result on this commit.

- For changes to a user journey, give the steps for success, failure and a safe way back. For shared UI, include keyboard, focus, trigger origin and reduced-motion results. [UX review](https://github.com/dvkam/kukai/issues/53)
- For runtime changes on a measured path, link the profile and comparable timings or explain why the path is unaffected. [Performance](https://github.com/dvkam/kukai/issues/52)
- For changed component contracts, link the usage example and the CI check for misuse. [Code quality](https://github.com/dvkam/kukai/issues/54)

## Before merge

Record the interrogate round, any fixes, the reviewed commit and its green lint, typecheck and test run. [Merge policy](https://github.com/dvkam/kukai/blob/production/docs/program/merge-policy.md)
